bullets.text: EE’s 5G+ Expansion - EE aims to cover 130 UK cities by 2025 with its newly branded 5G+ network.
VMO2 Launches Giga Sites - Virgin Media O2 introduces its first Giga Site in London, enhancing 5G connectivity.
Nokia Enhances RIC Tech - Nokia absorbs Juniper's RIC assets to boost its AI-driven network automation capabilities.
AI in 3GPP Release 19 - New standards embed AI in mobile networks, enhancing efficiency and performance.
Samsung Powers Vodafone's O-RAN - Samsung to supply Vodafone with vRAN and O-RAN solutions across Europe.
Private 5G & AI Convergence - The combination of private 5G and generative AI is driving Industry 4.0 innovations.
MS3 Joins Zen’s Fibre Hub - Zen Internet partners with MS3 to expand full fibre services in East Yorkshire.
Taliban Telecoms Blackout - Afghanistan faces a nationwide telecoms blackout, severely impacting access to essential services.
China Tightens Telecom Regulations - New rules restrict foreign telecom suppliers like Nokia and Ericsson in China.
Connectivity Gaps in Multifamily Properties - Survey reveals significant dissatisfaction with internet service quality in U.S. multifamily homes.
